stories.title: Seoul says South Korea and US vow close cooperation on North Korea
stories.summary: South Korea and the US agreed to maintain close communication and cooperation on resolving North Korea's nuclear issue and preserving peace on the Korean Peninsula. The US scaled back joint military exercises and praised North Korea, causing concern about potential strains in the US-South Korea alliance. Both countries plan to discuss pending issues like trade, investment, and security cooperation soon, aiming for mutually beneficial outcomes. South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke on Aug 24, and Seoul said they agreed to maintain close communication and cooperation on resolving the North Korean nuclear issue, South Korea’s Yonhap news agency reported. The US State Department issued only a brief statement on the phone call, which comes at a period of tension between the allies. President Donald Trump recently announced a scaling back of joint military exercises and praised nuclear-armed North Korea, while saying that Seoul had not helped his efforts to try to denuclearise Iran. The State Department said Rubio and Cho discussed “a range of issues in the US-ROK Alliance,” referring to South Korea by the initials of its official name, the Republic of Korea. “The Secretary noted the need for the two countries to remain in close coordination on matters that are integral to the Alliance,” it added. Yonhap said that in a statement on their talks, South Korea’s Foreign Ministry did not mention whether the diplomats reaffirmed their usual commitment to North Korea’s denuclearisation, despite their emphasis on the importance of cooperation on the North Korean nuclear issue. “The minister and secretary agreed to continue close communication and cooperation between South Korea and the US for peace on the Korean Peninsula and the resolution of North Korea’s nuclear issue while maintaining a solid combined defence posture,” Yonhap quoted the ministry release as saying. It cited Cho as saying that Seoul would do its best to help ensure Trump’s recent message for North Korea would lead to the resumption of dialogue between Washington and Pyongyang, and peace on the peninsula. Trump’s olive branch to North Korea’s Kim Jong Un last week, coupled with his criticism of Seoul, has raised concern among analysts that Trump’s unpredictability could strain alliances that have long maintained peace in Asia.

stories.title: US Supreme Court clears the way for Trump mail voting order in advance of midterms
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Monday cleared the way for US President Donald Trump to move ahead with his executive order restricting mail-in voting, though it remains unclear how much his administration can implement before the fast-approaching midterm elections. The decision appears to leave room for additional court challenges that could further slow Trump’s order. The US Postal Service laid out how it would implement the order last week but time is running short to impose major changes with some...
